svg.title: How the semi-Lagrangian reconstruction signs features thinner than two springl capsules
svg.text: Features thinner than two capsules: the wall fallback
a wall sample with no larger-U neighbor is inside
(a) Thick sheet
Walls on each face; the flood stops at them
and never reaches the interior: inside. The
fallback decides only the odd corner sample.
r: wall
U along the dashed column (bottom to top), and the sign
(b) Sheet thinner than two capsules
The two faces' walls merge: no interior is left
to be unreached. Its middle is a local maximum
of U with no upwind neighbor: inside (fallback).
r: wall
local max of U: inside
U along the dashed column (bottom to top), and the sign
(c) Outside gap thinner than two capsules
The same local maximum of U lies between two
bodies; the fallback makes it inside, so they
fuse: a union, the price of the rule.
r: wall
local max of U: inside
U along the dashed column (bottom to top), and the sign
